text: ObjectivesTo meet the needs of socialist society modernization, the postgraduates should attain the following objectives to be a senior talents developed morally, intellectually and physically in an all-round way.The post-graduates should meet the following objectives:1.Establishing the ideology of Patriotism and Collectivism and the scientific worldview and systematical methodology; mastering the fundamental principle of Dialectical Materialism and Historical Materialism; possessing both good professional ethics and scientific ethics; being well-behaved and physical and mental healthy2.Being equipped with a solidly basic theories and systematically specialized knowledge of the field of Business Administration to solve theoretical and practical problems in management field with proper operation of theory and method of management, information technology, systematical analyze method of qualitative and quantitative, and Corresponding engineering technology3 Have a rigorous Research attitude, good cooperation spirit and strong communication skills and life-long learning ability4 Master a foreign language, capable of reading the documents of this field, engaging in international communication and composing an academic paper5 Being physical and mental healthy
